items.summary: Risk disposition: SearchWoot go-live is blocked; keep private. Woot documentation proves API access but not commercial/public display, derivative, caching, alerting, affiliate, or advertising rights. Human counsel is required for source-rights, privacy/jurisdiction, and any future monetization decision. Ordinary bounded growth elsewhere is conditional, not blocked by incomplete telemetry; do not make unsupported revenue or ROI claims. Launch-readiness tracking remains active: zero legal tasks closed. Next evidence actions are to prepare an unsent Woot permission request, produce the repository-derived data-flow and retention table, capture deployed consent and GA4 configuration, and inventory logs, vendors, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use dispositions: Woot deal and price-history data—blocked; missing written provider permission, field-level provenance, permitted retention/display/alerts, freshness, correction, and takedown rules; smallest action is prepare an unsent permission request. User alert rules and sync results—evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention/deletion/correction workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior; smallest action is produce a read-only data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics—conditional for measurement-only use if consent-gated; evidence_needed for deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 sharing and retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction review; smallest action is capture current configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data—evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures; smallest action is produce the read-only operator and vendor inventory. No legal task is closed because none has complete evidence.

Privacy, consent, terms, cookie and analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, data provenance and rights, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive review remain conditional or evidence-needed where the supplied checklist lacks evidence. Do not infer adult status from domain names. Amazon attribution remains an evidence boundary: $4.92 is aggregate and unattributed, so site revenue, margin, ROI, CAC, payback, profitability, and forecasts are unsupported. Retain no new implementation or monetization action this cycle.
